healing.title: A Tarot for Healing, Not Fear
healing.description: Replacing the old symbols of doom with understanding and regenerative Light.

system.title: Everything Begins at Zero
system.description: The Sun is the Zero Point from which five elements radiate: Aether, Air, Fire, Water, and Earth.

about.title: Rebuilding the Lighthouse
about.description: The Tower wasn't meant to be a ruin. It was meant to be a beacon. We are rebuilding the shattered languages of humanity into a single, unified light.

source.title: The Zero Point as the Source of Creation
source.text: The zero point is defined as the origin of existence, the 'womb of the night' from which the rhythm of life is born and the spirit wakes. It is not a distant location but the 'innermost center of all our hearts', located where silence begins. In terms of creation, this point represents a 'silent big bang in the center of the chest', marking the genesis of the spirit and the universe itself. It involves 'giving birth to the universe' while simultaneously 'giving birth to myself'.

innerSun.title: The Inner Sun and the Reactor of Love
innerSun.text: The inner sun redefines the traditional view of power. It is not the physical star in the sky but the 'core in your chest', functioning as the reactor of love. This internal mechanism burns away fear and mass, allowing you to 'climb the slope' toward hope. By staring at the 'center of the inner sun', dualities merge into one, unlocking the gate to spiritual freedom.

realization.title: Self-Realization through Internal Integration
realization.text: True realization occurs when one wakes up 'lucid right inside of the dream'. The 'sun lighthouse' acts as a guide, cutting through the fog of the mind and ego to redirect you back to the internal garden—the zero point already existing within. The enemy is gone because 'the hero is me'.

system.zeroPointDesc: The Sun is pure consciousness, the Source from which four elemental energies flow. Four angels orbit this central origin, each representing an element emerging from unity.
system.aetherDesc: The Major Arcana (0-9) is not a linear path, but a cyclical journey of awakening in the present moment. A continuous spiral of consciousness returning to itself.

guide.title: The Daily Guide – 'Lily's Guide'
guide.subtitle: A Dual Gateway to Spirit and Play

role.title: Purpose of the Guide
role.desc: To serve as a dual tool: a Rulebook for 'The Hidden Garden' board game, and a deep Interpretive Guide for the Tarot deck.
role.concept: Concept: An essential part of the project, with potential for future development as a standalone book.

structure.title: Structure & Content
structure.desc: Designed as a Flip Book – one side as a Tarot Guide (with positive and empowering interpretations for the 46 cards), and the other side as a Game Oracle (detailing Dialogue Mechanics and Maze Rules).

premise.title: The Premise
premise.desc: The world is in a grey 'Daydream'. Players ('Awakeners') embark on a journey through the Card Maze to restore the Lost Garden, transforming 'Blockages' instead of fighting enemies.

mechanics.title: Core Mechanics: Elemental Dialogue
mechanics.desc: A dance of elements (like emotional Rock-Paper-Scissors) to soothe Blockages: Water heals Fire, Air clarifies Earth. The game takes place on a modular 3x3 grid with archetypal characters.

participation.title: Shape the Deck
participation.desc: The Sunlight Tarot is not just a product, but a living project. We invite you to vote on card designs, suggest meanings, and help us choose the final 46 cards that resonate most.

openSource.title: Open Source Wisdom
openSource.desc: We believe wisdom belongs to everyone. The core philosophy, the game mechanics, and the digital assets will be available for the community to explore, expand, and evolve.

coins.title: Coins - Earth/Matter
coins.desc: Path of Manifestation & Abundance. From raw potential to realized wealth through labor and balance.

roses.title: Roses - Air/Mind
roses.desc: Path of Thought & Communication. The mind's journey through clarity, conflict, and wisdom.

cards.title: Cards - Fire/Will
cards.desc: Path of Action & Passion. The will's expression through creative force and transformation.

aether.title: Aether - Consciousness
aether.desc: The Fifth Element that contains all others. Pure awareness manifesting as archetypal journeys.

vision.lighthouseDesc: The Tower of Babylon reimagined as an active lighthouse and vertical paradise. Every crack filled with blooming lavender and climbing roses, inhabitants tending gardens at multiple levels, the bright beacon guiding distant travelers home.

unity.title: Unity Through Diversity
unity.desc: Multiple interpretations strengthening one truth. Where the original tower fell through confusion, we reunify through universal symbols.

rosetta.title: The Sun Rosetta
rosetta.desc: By centering the Sun as our philosophical anchor, we acknowledge that all spiritual systems ultimately point toward enlightenment.

enneagram.title: Enneagram Integration
enneagram.desc: The ancient ninefold system forms our structural backbone, transforming readings from fortune-telling to self-understanding.

vertical.title: Vertical Integration
vertical.desc: Connecting base consciousness to higher awareness. Each card becomes a step in the ascent.

healing.title: A Tarot for Healing, Not Fear
healing.subtitle: The Sunlight Tarot transforms traditional imagery to create a psychologically healing 'white deck' rather than a fear-based 'black deck.'

death.title: Death → Fear
death.desc: The reaper, the end, the void. Imagery designed to frighten and control.

devil.title: Devil → Bondage
devil.desc: Chains, suffering, matter as prison. Punishment and limitation.

tower.title: Tower → Destruction
tower.desc: Catastrophe, collapse, divine punishment falling from above.

tree.title: Tree of Life → Transformation
tree.desc: Passage through the Kabbalistic Tree. Death as doorway, not destination.

merkaba.title: Merkaba → Sacred Descent
merkaba.desc: Matter as teacher, geometry of incarnation. Body as temple, not trap.

lighthouse.title: Lighthouse → Guidance
lighthouse.desc: Destruction becoming creation. Ruins as fertile ground, beacon of hope.

daily.intro: Take a moment to contemplate the card drawn for you. Visualize, breathe into, or speak aloud its meaning. If it doesn't resonate, simply draw another until you find your match.

scrollMaze.title: Coming Soon: ScrollMaze
scrollMaze.subtitle: Transform the Sunlight Tarot into a roguelike adventure game
scrollMaze.feature1Desc: Lay out cards face-down to create an ever-changing maze. Flip cards to reveal rooms, roll dice to determine encounters.
scrollMaze.feature2Desc: Battle monsters using the five-element system. Water douses fire, fire evaporates water - master the cycles to win.
scrollMaze.feature3Desc: Understanding each card's meaning gives you tactical advantage. Learn tarot through engaging gameplay, not memorization.
